source_name: World Bank — Monitoring Real-Time Labour Market Trends Through Online Job Vacancies: Kosovo
why_relevant: Methodological pointer that identifies which private Kosovo job portals carry the bulk of online vacancies and how they have been scraped since 2019 — it validates and scopes the job-ad channel this cell depends on, and names the portal universe to cover.

source_name: Poslovi Infostud — regional (sr) card/ATM banking vacancies as a comparator
why_relevant: Serbian-language banking job board carrying explicit card-and-ATM roles (e.g. 'Specijalista/kinja na poslovima upravljanja platnim karticama i monitoringom bankomata', Addiko Bank). Not Kosovo-domiciled, but it is the best sr-language comparator for role taxonomy and it may surface postings by regional groups covering Kosovo operations.

source_name: ASKdata — PxWeb statistical database (Kosovo Agency of Statistics)
why_relevant: Machine-queryable PxWeb warehouse holding the actual tables behind ASK publications, including dedicated folders 'Household Budget Survey', 'ICT in Households and Enterprise', 'Income and Living Conditions', 'Price', 'Statistical business register', 'Structural business statistics', 'National and government accounts', 'Short-term statistics'. PxWeb exposes a standard JSON-stat API, making this the single most automatable demand-side source in the cell.

source_name: ASK — Anketa e përdorimit të TIK-ut në ekonomitë familjare dhe individë (ICT usage survey, households/individuals)
why_relevant: Eurostat-model ICT survey covering the 16-74 population: internet and device access, internet use, e-shopping and e-government. This is the official series for digital-channel readiness and online-purchase behaviour underpinning e-commerce/card-not-present potential. Latest reporting indicates ~99.3% household internet access in 2025.

source_name: ASK — Anketa e të Ardhurave dhe Kushteve të Jetesës (SILC / Income and Living Conditions)
why_relevant: Income distribution, material deprivation and ability-to-pay indicators; the standard covariate set for explaining financial exclusion and cash reliance among low-income households. Present as its own PxWeb folder ('Income and Living Conditions').

source_name: ASK — Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HIPC) / Indeksi i Çmimeve të Konsumit, Serbian-language releases
why_relevant: Monthly price series (HIPC base 2015=100, prices collected in 10 municipalities incl. via internet and telephone). Deflator for any nominal payment-value series and an indicator of retail price/channel structure. Confirms ASK publishes the same releases under a full Serbian-language path (/sr/agencija-za-statistiku-kosova/).

source_name: ASK — Statistical Business Register / Repertori Statistikor i Ndërmarrjeve (monthly)
why_relevant: Monthly statistical repertory of businesses registered with ARBK, plus the RSB covering all public and private enterprises operating in Kosovo. Gives merchant-universe counts by NACE activity, size and municipality — the denominator for POS terminal penetration and acquiring addressable market.

source_name: ASK — Kalendari i Publikimeve (release calendar)
why_relevant: Forward schedule of every ASK release with delayed items flagged; the scheduling backbone for an automated collector — tells you when ABEF, TIK, SILC, HIPC and business-register outputs land, and warns of slippage.

source_name: ASK metadata export (SDMX/XML), Serbian endpoint
why_relevant: Machine-readable metadata export endpoint on the ASK CMS, exposing survey definitions, periodicity and methodology per statistical domain — ideal for building a source registry entry per series without hand-reading PDFs. Implies parallel _Sq/_En endpoints.

source_name: askapi.rks-gov.net — ASK publication PDF/file store
why_relevant: All ASK PDF publications (annual reports, yearbooks, ABEF, wage levels, business repertory) are served from GUID-named files on this host. Anchoring the collector on this host, resolved via the release pages, gives durable document URLs.

source_name: Vjetari Statistikor i Republikës së Kosovës (Statistical Yearbook)
why_relevant: Single consolidated annual compendium containing summary tables from every ASK domain including monetary/financial, ICT, prices and enterprise chapters — the fastest way to establish a baseline year and to spot series that exist but are not exposed in PxWeb.

source_name: ASK Annual Report (Raporti Vjetor) series
why_relevant: Describes ASK's full work programme, which surveys ran in which year and which are planned — the authoritative way to know whether ABEF/TIK were fielded in a given year and what new modules (e.g. e-commerce) are coming, rather than inferring from missing releases.

source_name: RKS Open Data portal (opendata.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Whole-of-government open data catalogue; likely republishes ASK and other institutions' datasets in machine-readable form and can reveal series (e.g. municipal, registry) not surfaced on the ASK site itself.

source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve (business registration authority)
why_relevant: The upstream administrative register that feeds ASK's statistical business register. Sole institution for business registration in Kosovo (under the Ministry of Industry/Trade); public registry search at rbk.rks-gov.net gives firm-level merchant universe data with activity codes and municipality.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — civic-society mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Open-data mirror (Open Data Kosovo lineage, code at github.com/opendatakosovo/open-arbk) of ~170k-268k registered businesses with owners, activities and statistics — far easier to query in bulk than the official registry for merchant-universe segmentation, at the cost of freshness/completeness risk.

source_name: ASK — Niveli i pagave në Kosovë (Wage levels) series
why_relevant: Annual wage-level publication drawing on the Statistical Business Register; wage formalisation and payroll levels are a leading determinant of account ownership and salary-crediting, a core driver of card issuance in Kosovo.

source_name: Kosovo media coverage of ASK releases (kallxo.com, teve1.info, info-ks.net)
why_relevant: Local outlets report ASK headline numbers within hours of publication and often quote figures before the PDF is indexed; useful as a low-cost change-detection tripwire for ABEF/TIK/HIPC releases and for the Serbian-language read (info-ks.net tags 'Agencija za statistiku Kosova').

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Annual Reports / Raportet vjetore
why_relevant: Landing page listing annual report PDFs for 2010-2025 from Kosovo's largest-network bank; RBKO annual reports carry branch counts, ATM/self-service network size, card portfolio and e/m-banking user figures that CBK publishes only in aggregate.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Branches & ATMs page (Degët dhe Bankomatët)
why_relevant: Network page with branch/ATM locator map; bank marketing text on the site states 'over 160 ATMs', giving a per-institution ATM count refreshed continuously rather than annually.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — Publikimet financiare (SQ section)
why_relevant: Albanian-language mirror of the financial publications hub; useful because some interim/quarterly statements appear only in the SQ tree. Note: the exact deep path used in search results ('/shq/rreth-nesh/publikimet-financiare/raportet-vjetore/') returned 404 on one fetch — treat as moved/renamed, not dead.

source_name: TEB Sh.A. Kosovo — Annual Report PDFs
why_relevant: Verified content-rich: the 2024 report contains a 'Card and POS Business' section, an explicit 'POS Terminals 5,593 Total' figure, and branch expansion ('opened 4 new branches, bringing the total number to 34, up from 30 in 2023'), plus sector commentary (e-banking accounts >1 million, POS transactions +32%). This is exactly the per-institution ATM/POS/card granularity the cell targets.

source_name: NLB Banka Prishtina — Annual Reports / Raportet vjetore
why_relevant: Deepest disclosure cadence found in the cell: annual reports, quarterly/interim financial statements and external auditor reports for 2012 through 2026 (statements already posted for March and June 2026). Gives higher-frequency tracking of one systemic bank than any annual-only source.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare Kosovë (BKT Kosova) — Raportet / Annual Reports
source_subtype: bank report hub + audited IFRS statements
why_relevant: BKT Kosova publishes annual reports, audited IFRS statements and financial indicators as a separate legal entity since its 2019 split from BKT Albania, so Kosovo-only network/card figures are isolable.

source_name: BKT Kosova — audited IFRS financial statements PDFs
why_relevant: Full audited IFRS statements with notes for BKT Kosova (incl. BKT Pay subsidiary), the layer where fee/commission income from cards and payment services can be isolated per institution.

source_name: Banka për Biznes (BPB) — Raporti Vjetor & audited statements
source_subtype: bank annual report + auditor report PDFs
why_relevant: BPB posts Albanian-language annual reports and independent auditor reports back to at least 2016 on its WordPress uploads tree; a mid-size domestic bank whose card/POS acquiring scale is otherwise invisible.

source_name: Banka Ekonomike — Të dhënat financiare / Financial Indicators
why_relevant: Publishes financial indicators (CAR, ROAA) and references shareholder-meeting annual reports and auditor reports (2025 cycle noted in an AGM notice dated 20 Apr 2026). Strategically important now: Banka Ekonomike took over the assets and liabilities of Türkiye İş Bankası – Kosovo Branch on CBK approval dated 29 Jul 2025, so its network figures absorb another actor.

source_name: Banka Ekonomike — Branch and ATM network list
why_relevant: Explicit 'view as a list' branch and ATM network page (separate Google-Maps layers for branches and ATMs); enumerable ATM count for a domestic bank that publishes no ATM total in prose.
